links.outcome: Local diagnostic accuracy of AI POCUS versus histopathology in local patients
links.effect: Sensitivity 67.2%, specificity 79.4%, PPV 70.3% at 51% threshold; AUC 0.76, moderate discriminatory performance
links.quote: Among 159 participants, Breast AI achieved a sensitivity of 67.2%, specificity of 79.4% and PPV of 70.3% at a 51% threshold.

links.outcome: Selection of decision threshold using F1 score and derivation of three-tier risk model
links.effect: F1 analysis identified 51% as optimal cut-off (F1 = 65.7%); three tiers: <30% low, 30-51% intermediate, >51% high
links.quote: F1 score analysis identified 51% as the optimal cut-off (F1 = 65.7%).

screen.reason: Prospective cohort study evaluating real-time diagnostic performance of an AI-enabled POCUS device in a live clinical setting prior to biopsy, but it assesses overall model performance rather than comparing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
